summary: Chagee Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its board approved a special cash dividend of approximately US$1.95 per ordinary share and per ADS, payable on or about December 4, 2026 to holders of record as of November 23, 2026. The board also adopted a three-year annual dividend policy committing to distribute no less than 50% of prior-year net income each year starting with fiscal 2027. The company reported RMB6,567.5 million (US$967.9 million) in cash and restricted cash as of June 30, 2026. Watch payout sustainability and ADS depositary fee treatment.
